proposed_facts.reason: C definition and public header use two u8 parameters; floating participant average is scaled by 100 with a zero-match guard.
Canonical signature uses u8 mode; both domains multiply the floating hit ratio by 100 twice and guard zero attacks.
Header consumers use helpers adding 0x1C to the fighter-base pointer; GetNameText returns persistent namedata, not localized fighter labels.
OnFrame installs the exit callback on its main-screen argument; the callback updates arrows and requests destruction at or beyond the end frame.
Main-screen exit registration and popup Back handling are distinct paths; popup cancellation does not install ExitAnimProc.
Init creates a separate input GObj after CreateScreen; InputProc replaces processes on that argument and removes it before adjacent-page initialization.
The helper sums vs_kos over all valid target names without a self exclusion; the contextual stat switch reads victories separately.
Forward KO allocation is enabled for all fighter comparisons, independently of the equal-ID SD branch; diagonal name mode omits that forward field.
The minimum begins at fighter zero without an unlock test. Qualification of the intended eligible-minimum interpretation is appropriate.
Verified the all-zero preflight, strict minimum replacement, unlocked zero-count rejection and separate equal-time ambiguity pass.
Stable shift insertion precedes an unlock-filtered outer loop; tie scans re-evaluate callbacks, omit unlock filtering and mutate the outer index.
Input branches establish the stated priority and byte limits. Cursor transforms establish high-byte X and low-byte Y; raw name-origin navigation differs from permutation-based visible lookup.
Back removes the active modal process, reinstalls normal input on the supplied independent input object, copies flags, destroys the popup and clears its pointer.
Modal and normal callbacks share the independently constructed input object; Diagram state is obtained through the global main-screen handle.
Mode-switch callers supply name or unlocked-fighter counts; the helper accesses exactly raw slots 7/8 and 6/5 without viewport reads.
Grid loops and coordinate writes establish seven entry columns and ten entry rows; coarse count thresholds are separate from boundary-sensitive updates.
The complete helper contains only two count-based visibility tests, supporting the count-only purpose without inferred arrow orientation.
Inclusive thresholds and raw pointer-slot pairs match every branch of the canonical implementation.
Arrow consumers pair low-byte rank ten with JObjs 3/4 and high-byte rank seven with JObjs 6/5; cursor rendering independently establishes the axes.
The signature is callback-compatible, but the examined owned callers invoke the helper synchronously from OnFrame and ExitAnimProc.
Each invocation updates four animations; only forward directions scan eligible entries, while reverse directions test origin bytes for nonzero.
All four slot guards and both domain sentinels match canonical branches. Deferring authored visual orientation avoids relying on contradictory comments.
Grid dimensions, packed axes, exact-one numeric mode test, zero/one animation paths and menu/page exit branches agree with the source and functionality document.
The local text alias remains text[0]; text[3] is unconditionally repositioned from node13 after node3. Exact frame equality removes the process, whose removal can be deferred.

Construction publishes the main object, clears both origins, preserves the supplied state and saved mode bytes, and registers HSD_Free. Only zero builds immediately and only state one completes deferred entry.

contradictions.reason: Accept the two signature corrections: canonical byte parameters contradict the stale int-mode descriptions. Supported arithmetic semantics remain retained.
Accept the name-header correction: pointer origin does not identify the accessed permutation, and persistent nametag text is not localized fighter text.

Accept main-screen exit and independent-input ownership corrections. The popup-oriented frame-table name does not establish popup ownership; modal cancellation restores input on the separately allocated input object.
Accept the KO-versus-victories correction and rejection of the VS/Misc screen conflation. Shared statistic helpers do not make the two screen implementations identical.
Accept the diagonal-popup correction: fighter mode retains forward KO text in addition to the equal-ID SD field; the broader replacement interpretation is incorrect.

Accept least-played and ranked-selection corrections. Preserve the untested zero seed, separate ambiguity passes, unfiltered tie participants and repeated callbacks. A universal fighter-zero unlock guarantee remains explicitly deferred.

Accept all transposed-axis, arrow-slot, arrow-update and synchronous-helper corrections. Drawing establishes seven X columns and ten Y rows, while exact slot tests avoid assuming authored arrow orientation. Reverse availability is a raw nonzero-origin test, not an eligibility search.

Accept the file-level lifecycle correction and added constructor details. Numeric states must not be normalized into a generic terminal-state model; menu departure and same-menu page replacement follow different paths.

Accept all 18 section-attribution fact deferrals and four section-attribution link deferrals. Retain supported source-level resource, configuration, color, formatting and arithmetic roles, but declarations, overlays, ASSERT_SIZE and an order hack cannot establish compiled membership, adjacency, extent or constant-pool layout.

unresolved: Compiled section membership, extent, adjacency, diagnostic-string placement and constant-pool layout remain unverified; the upstream section-attribution deferrals are accepted.
Authored visual orientation of arrow assets remains unestablished; exact slots, thresholds and packed-byte consumers are documented instead.
No universal fighter-zero unlock guarantee was established; the least-played explanation correctly preserves the unchecked seed.
Cross-file sparse-name aggregation assumptions and active-object deferred-destruction behavior remain accepted owner-review deferrals from the handoff.
